Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 CURSOR lt_test_id_cur(in_inst_test_id VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT test_id
 FROM valid_instrument_tests vit
 WHERE vit.chapter_id = :UPLOAD_STATUS_CTRL.CHAPTER_ID
 AND UPPER(vit.machine_id) = UPPER(:UPLOAD_STATUS_CTRL.INSTRUMENT_ID)
 --AND UPPER(vit.machine_test_id) = UPPER(in_inst_test_id) -- Commented by Kishore on 08/11/2014. IM 10070
 AND vit.machine_test_id = in_inst_test_id -- Added by Kishore on 08/11/2014. IM 10070
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE+1);
 
 CURSOR lt_result_cur(in_inst_result VARCHAR2) IS 
 SELECT result_status
 FROM valid_instrument_test_results vitr
 WHERE vitr.chapter_id = :UPLOAD_STATUS_CTRL.CHAPTER_ID
 AND UPPER(vitr.machine_id) = UPPER(:UPLOAD_STATUS_CTRL.INSTRUMENT_ID)
 AND UPPER(vitr.machine_result_status) = UPPER(in_inst_result)
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE+1);
BEGIN
 IF :UPLOAD_STATUS_UNITS_DB.MACHINE_TEST_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 OPEN lt_test_id_cur(:UPLOAD_STATUS_UNITS_DB.MACHINE_TEST_ID);
 FETCH lt_test_id_cur INTO :UPLOAD_STATUS_UNITS_DB.S_LT_TEST_ID;
 CLOSE lt_test_id_cur;
 END IF;
 
 IF :UPLOAD_STATUS_UNITS_DB.MACHINE_RESULT IS NOT NULL THEN
 OPEN lt_result_cur(:UPLOAD_STATUS_UNITS_DB.MACHINE_RESULT);
 FETCH lt_result_cur INTO :UPLOAD_STATUS_UNITS_DB.S_LT_RESULT;
 CLOSE lt_result_cur;
 END IF; 
 
 IF :UPLOAD_STATUS_UNITS_DB.UPLOAD_STATUS = 'S' THEN
 :UPLOAD_STATUS_UNITS_DB.S_UPLOAD_STATUS := 'Loaded';
 ELSIF :UPLOAD_STATUS_UNITS_DB.UPLOAD_STATUS = 'E' THEN
 :UPLOAD_STATUS_UNITS_DB.S_UPLOAD_STATUS := 'Error';
 ELSIF :UPLOAD_STATUS_UNITS_DB.UPLOAD_STATUS = 'A' THEN
 :UPLOAD_STATUS_UNITS_DB.S_UPLOAD_STATUS := 'Aborted';
 ELSE
 :UPLOAD_STATUS_UNITS_DB.S_UPLOAD_STATUS := NULL;
 END IF; 
END;

declare

begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then

 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0)
 then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then

 else

 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;

 /*Added by HCLC for removing double message */

 null;

 ||': '||error_text,1,80));

 check_package_failure;
 end;
